t: You're at the site of Clerkenwell Priory, which was the English headquarters of the Knights Hospitallers of St John of Jerusalem. It was the home of their Grand Prior in England, and the order followed the Rule of Saint Augustine. Its wealth came from land, including farmland in the parish of Marylebone, which it rented out to tenants for produce and income. The poet Anne Southwell, who lived from 1574 to 1636, was born here. Her commonplace book collects political poems, sonnets, occasional verse and letters to friends.
